searchText: This is not about code introspection, but about being able to have factory contacts: a contract which is able to deploy new previously unseen contracts. Ahhhh gotcha! With the older version supplying the containers to the factory contract was not possible, and with this EIP it is. Had not though about it that way 🙂 Yup makes sense, thanks! 😄
